Text:
Wutai's white rose─
the one and only Yuffie!
There's nothing better than the sight of so many eager workers! With your help, we'll build a base on this star every bit as cosmotastic as the others!
Habitation modules will ensure that every new recruit can live upon this star in comfort!
Take what components you need and assemble them on-site. It goes without saying that we expect your best work!
I can see them now: the smiling faces of workers assured they have a place to rest their weary bones. I promise the habitation modules will impress!
Proper beds enable proper rest, and that makes for a happy worker! If your tasks for the day are done, feel free to take a break!
This joint project shall give us shiny new energization and hydrofication stations!
We can't achieve our lofty goals without energy, and that's where energization stations come in! They'll convert the star's aether into a limitless supply of power.
Take what components you need and assemble them on-site. It goes without saying that we expect your best work!
The first of our two joint projects is set to finish without issue! Excellent work!
Next on the docket is a hydrofication station! We'll be starting right away, so keep your tools handy!
The second of our joint projects is now underway!
No project can succeed without a steady supply of water for our thirsty workers! Building a hydrofication station will ensure that no throat goes parched for long!
Take the components you need and assemble them on-site!  They're delicate and have high aetheric conductivity, so handle the parts with the utmost care!
The project is heading towards completion on schedule! We'll soon be swimming in potable water!
It's almost looking like an entirely new base! Everyone deserves a luxurious rest once your work is done!
Our investigation has discovered that the tall structure in the Netroot Radius, called the Sprouting Towerling, was essential to the city's systems.
However, it seems the withered roots of the plant prevent energy from reaching the surrounding area.
Good thing we have a formula that perks plant life right up! Spray it all over and get that energy flowing!
I see every ilm of the roots has been covered! Now we need only wait to see the fruits of our labor!
Bringing the Sprouting Towerling back to life will bring us one step closer to restoring the city to its former glory! What will it look like? I can't wait to find out!
To speed up analysis of the Sprouting Towerling, we're going to outfit the Timberlodge with even more cosmotastic facilities!
All we need to do is install an aether converter, bump up the output from the energization stations, and expand the base's network! Then analysis will speed along like a jackrabbit!
While we're at it, we'll build more paths so everyone can get around more easily. An excellent plan, yes?
And with this, our analysis is just a stone's throw away from completion! Everyone who helped deserves a hearty round of applause!
I encourage anyone whose tasks are finished to take a well-earned rest and await the results of our analysis!
The second tower is within sight, but our way is blocked by a veritable jungle of overgrowth!
That's why we've developed a brand-new machine to cut through the thickest foliage! We've dubbed it the “Cosmic Harvester”!
Take the required parts and assemble them into a cosmic, plant-cutting contraption!
The Cosmic Harvester is coming along nicely! If they could, those plants around the tower would surely be cowering in fear!
Just what was the function of the Sunning Towerling? It's our job to find out!
It appears the structure draws power from nearby mineral deposits.
Yet now the power conduits are completely unresponsive─we can't hope to make any progress like this.
Drill off chunks of a manageable size and channel their energy into the power conduits!
I think we almost have enough indicolite! I can almost feel the power flowing into the Sunning Towerling─yes, soon its former glory shall be restored!
Rest your weary paws if your work is done, and watch this ancient structure come alive!
The cosmoport will soon be even better! Every corner of the firmament will be ours to explore!
Once the upgrades are complete, Etheirys will be only a quick hop away!
Take what components you need and assemble them on-site. It goes without saying that we expect your best work!
And that brings another planned project to an end. If your work is finished, take a well-earned rest and drink in the fruits of your labor!
Ships will be able to land with ease, and that means even more supplies and personnel!
We've discovered yet another structure within the depths of the Stratostone Stand─the Rooting Towerling. However, we as of yet lack a clear path to it!
So our plan is to attach specialized parts to the Voyagers' abandoned drones and thus give them purpose anew!
Then we'll send them off to cultivate the vegetation and shape it into walkable paths!
Good, good! The drones are almost ready to go. We only need to power them up!
If you've finished your work, take a well-earned rest. It's only a matter of time until the plants guide us deeper into the Stratostone Stand!
We've tuned the powersuits especially for this task, so get them on and get to work!
We should be able to restore this new structure in the same way we restored the Sunning Towerling, but we'll need a lot more energy this time!
Carve the indicolite into the largest pieces you can manage and haul them over to the tower's power conduits!
Wonderful! The indicolite is flowing! Keep going and we'll have a comfy surplus of energy to keep the tower going!
Even with the aid of the powersuits, you went above and beyond our expectations! Everyone whose work is done deserves some rest and recuperation!
Our future projects require even better mechs, so an upgrade of cosmic magnitude is in order!
Our current maintenance demands are almost overwhelming, but the completion of this project should make everyone's lives easier!
Take what components you need and assemble them on-site. It goes without saying that we expect your best work!
Now that's a mech hangar to be proud of! Excellent work, everyone!
Just imagine the projects we can undertake now! If your work is finished, take a break until your next exciting task!
Upgrading the mech hangar has enabled the vacuum suits to haul massive containers of alchemical supplies!
Into the suits! Up on high, there's plenty of vegetation practically crying out for our growth formula!
That should let us revitalize every plant in the area, and make it just like when the land was suffuse with aether!
There we go! Every ilm is covered in the growth formula!
If your work is done, feel free to get out of your vacuum suit and take a breather!
Grandma Laurel was the city's core system─its brain, if you will!
Our objective from this point on is to restore the system and its connections to the surrounding facilities by making the aether flow!
Let's start by covering the dome's interior and the base of the towers with growth formula. That should get everything connected and fired up!
That should do it! With growth formula covering every corner and crevice, the plants should naturally enhance the flow of aether!
This project will put a capstone on our work here on Auxesia! Watch as Grandma Laurel returns!
<whirr>
Connecting to trunk network...
Truly, we could not have asked for better workers than you lot. I hope our next project together is sooner rather than later!
